description.es-ES: Las cartas de Santa Teresa de Jesús (1546–1582) en la edición del P. Silverio de Santa Teresa: unos 430 escritos a sus hermanos, a las prioras de sus conventos, a los Padres Gracián y Mariano, a Felipe II y a muchos otros, con el resumen y las notas de Silverio. Una carta por capítulo, numerada como en su edición.
description.en-US: The letters of St. Teresa of Jesus (1546-1582) in P. Silverio de Santa Teresa's edition: some 430 letters to her brothers, the prioresses of her convents, Fathers Gracián and Mariano, Philip II and many others, with Silverio's summaries and notes. One letter per chapter, numbered as in his edition (Spanish only; the Stanbrook English is a separate book).
description.pt-BR: As cartas de Santa Teresa de Jesus (1546-1582) na edição do P. Silverio de Santa Teresa: cerca de 430 cartas aos irmãos, às prioras dos conventos, aos padres Graciano e Mariano, a Filipe II e a muitos outros, com os resumos e notas de Silverio. Uma carta por capítulo, numerada como na edição dele.

sources.edition: Obras de Sta. Teresa de Jesús, ed. P. Silverio de Santa Teresa, C.D., t. 7: Epistolario (I): cartas I–CLVII (Biblioteca Mística Carmelitana), Burgos: El Monte Carmelo, 1922. Wellesley College scan, the only OCR used.
sources.description: Spanish critical text of the letters with Silverio's headings (addressee, place and date), summaries and notes kept as footnotes; his introduction, indexes and appendices are not included. Single-scan OCR cleaned by script, not proofread.
sources.tierEvidence: Teresa died in 1582; the volume was published in 1922 (public domain in the US) and P. Silverio died in 1954, so his notes are public domain under life+70 since 1 January 2025.
